name: io.github.mattoddie/hive-mcp
title: Hive heating
description: Check and control Hive smart heating: thermostats, radiator valves, hot water and holiday mode

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Docker volume for the login (tokens and the remembered device), so it survives restarts. Use the same volume for `hive-mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP over stdio (the image defaults to HTTP).

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The email address you log in to the Hive app with.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Hive password, used to log in and to log in again by itself as a remembered device.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_ALLOW_LOGIN_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Let the assistant log in for you with an SMS code (hive_auth_start and hive_auth_complete).

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow changes to your home: heating, boosts, hot water, holiday mode, plugs and lights. Off means read-only.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_MAX_TEMP
environmentVariables.description: The highest heating target the assistant may set, in °C: 5 to 32 in steps of 0.5.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets to expose fewer tools, e.g. home,heating,hotwater. Empty means all but raw.

environmentVariables.name: HIVE_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional audit log of every change and login: stderr, or a file on the volume such as /data/audit.jsonl.
